summary: Nu Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing its first Investor Day scheduled for December 8, 2026 in New York City. The event will feature presentations by the CEO and senior management covering long-term strategy and growth. This is a routine corporate communications filing with no special-situation transaction, structural change, or event affecting shareholders. It is simply an invitation to an investor presentation, with no deal terms, board actions, or strategic alternatives involved.
